definitions.alert: An analysis is listed when it has at least one novelty flag, one contamination flag, or one open urgent review. Analyses with none of these are not alerts.
definitions.contamination_flag: A sequence with contamination_flagged = true (as in GET /partner/summary). contamination_types counts results[].contamination_type over the flagged sequences ('unrecorded' when absent).
definitions.novelty_flag: Same rule as GET /partner/summary: result_class is not known_species and it is possible_novelty or has novelty_score >= the deployment's novelty threshold.
definitions.order: urgent first, then by analysis created_at, newest first.
definitions.priority: urgent: the analysis has at least one open review (submitted, triaged or needs_evidence) with triage_priority urgent. The worker queues a review as urgent when a sequence's novelty_score is >= 0.70 or a contamination flag is not expected for its route (human DNA on the human route is expected, so flagged but not queued); a curator can also set urgent at triage. flagged: any other alert. No other severity is assigned.
definitions.scope: Uploads and analyses are selected by owner (user_id) and by their own created_at within [date_from, date_to] (UTC, both days inclusive), as in GET /partner/summary. An alert is one in-scope analysis; its upload is looked up whatever its own created_at.
